filtered_sum.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE amount > 500

grouped_sum.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM events GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

join.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(e.amount) FROM events e JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id=c.customer_id

small_left_join.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(e.amount) FROM customers c JOIN events e ON c.customer_id=e.customer_id

topn.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events ORDER BY amount DESC, event_id LIMIT 20

arithmetic_projection.sql: SELECT event_id, amount * 2 + 1 AS adjusted FROM events WHERE event_id < 10000 ORDER BY event_id

medium_groups.sql: SELECT customer_id % 1024 AS bucket, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM events GROUP BY customer_id % 1024 ORDER BY bucket

high_groups.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM events GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id

multi_aggregate.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MIN(amount), MAX(amount), AVG(amount) FROM events GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

grouped_join.sql: SELECT e.category, COUNT(*), SUM(e.amount) FROM events e JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY e.category ORDER BY e.category
